description: Open-top 100 x 70 x 70 mm box that files resistor-kit bags on edge like index cards, with a thumb scoop in each end wall for pinching a bag out, and a push-on lid with an inner locating lip.
printing_notes: Print both parts as exported, without supports: the box floor-down, the lid top-face-down (its locating lip rises from the bed). Any filament; PLA is fine on a bench.

Bags stand on their long edge along the 100 mm length and file across the 70 mm width like index cards; a 25-value 1/4 W kit fills the width. Use the end-wall scoops to pinch one bag's end and lift it out.

The lid's lip drops 5 mm inside the walls with 0.3 mm of clearance per side; if it is tight or loose, adjust lid_clearance by 0.1 mm and re-render only the lid. Push a thumb up through an end scoop to lift the lid.
outer_l, outer_w, outer_h and wall are shared parameters: change them on both the box and the lid.
